# The CI gate ignores a finding only when its rule AND file match a line here; anything else
# still fails the job. Keep reasons specific, and remove a line when the code changes.

column3: The admin CLI shows a newly issued API key once to the operator in their terminal, by design (like GitHub/AWS key creation). It is printed, never logged, and only its sha256 is stored.

API keys are 256-bit random tokens, not user passwords, so there is no dictionary to attack; an indexed SHA-256 lookup is the standard for such tokens. A slow password hash (scrypt/argon2) would cost CPU on every request without adding security.
